cases.title: getLocalEventGenerator()
inputs:
syncProgress = await getLocalSyncProgress({
    common: context.common,
    filters: eventCallbacks.map(({ filter }) => filter),
    chain,
    rpc,
    finalizedBlock: await eth_getBlockByNumber(rpc, ["0x1", true]),
    cachedIntervals,
  })

    common: context.common,
    chain,
    rpc,
    eventCallbacks,

    database,
    from: syncProgress.getCheckpoint({ tag: "start" })!,
    to: syncProgress.getCheckpoint({ tag: "finalized" })!,
    limit: 100,
    isCatchup: false,
  })

mapping.assertion_policy: Complete pinned historical.test.ts executes all 14 unchanged declarations and 29 assertions under explicit loopback startup adaptation. Only these three original cases and five assertions earn M37 credit. Each backend replays three actual coordinator calls, seven provider requests and six direct clock observations in full normal/race runs. All three originals are single-chain Multichain calls, including the misleadingly named omnichain case. Mandatory supplemental genuine multichain, omnichain, isolated, refetch and checkpoint probes earn zero source credit. Native state is produced from original inputs and raw RPC; outputs and physical snapshots are verification-only. Outer run-loop transactions, realtime cutover and readiness are not covered. Native PGlite atomicity is a documented safety extension, not identical source transaction failure behavior.

runtime_validation.meaning: Three original single-chain coordinator cases, five assertions, both real backends and complete native modes. Separate genuine multi-chain and helper probes earn zero source credit. Outer indexing transactions and realtime cutover remain out of scope.
